name: Cadence
author: MarshalX
description: Your swing, the global cooldown, your cast with a latency band, and your resource with combo points as pips, on one strip. Optional rows add your offhand swing, your target's swing and your speed.

preview.alt: On the left, Casting, four thin bars on a bare strip: swing, global cooldown, cast, resource. On the right, Combo points, the same four on a rogue, over a row of combo pips.

settings.label: Show your offhand swing timer while dual-wielding
Show your target's swing timer, under your own
Show your movement speed when something is affecting it
Show your resource and combo points
Draw the latency band on the cast bar
Hide the strip while you are not fighting
